title: The dry run passed. Nothing was written
body: The Pixel 7 Pro (cheetah) is unlocked and runs from slot a; bootloader fake-1.0, baseband fake-radio-1.0.
Google's factory image for build TEST.260101.001 is the right file (cheetah-test.260101.001-factory-31c2322a.zip).
User alex (PIN), phone name alex-phone, time zone Europe/Paris, Wi-Fi not set.
The release's images were not fetched for this dry run, so the list is the signed plan's. An install would send these writes, and only these:
footer: The dry run only asked the phone questions. It has written nothing to it.
This run was a dry run, and it ends here: a dry run has no step that writes to a phone.
